description: Address review findings: fix theme hydration flash with blocking script, add error state to Load More button, prevent re-animation on appended cards, fix sticky header overlapping content, and add clarifying comment for region-to-platform mapping.
steps: 1. Fix theme hydration flash in app/layout.tsx by adding a blocking inline script that reads localStorage and sets the dark class before first paint.
2. Add transient error state to Load More in app/components/Dashboard.tsx so users see feedback when a fetch fails.
3. Track batch start index in app/components/MatchHistory.tsx and only apply fadeSlideUp animation to newly appended cards.
4. Fix sticky header content overlap in app/components/Dashboard.tsx by adding scroll-padding-top or top padding.
5. Add clarifying comment to REGION_TO_PLATFORM in lib/types.ts explaining the best-effort default mapping limitation.
acceptance_criteria: No theme flash for light-mode users on page load - blocking script sets class before paint
Load More button shows error feedback when fetch fails and allows retry
Only newly appended match cards animate; existing cards do not re-animate on Load More
Sticky header does not overlap the first match card content
REGION_TO_PLATFORM has a comment explaining the limitation
npm run lint passes with zero errors
npm run build passes with zero errors
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-league-tracker && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
findings: All 5 review issues addressed. React 19 ESLint rule (react-hooks/refs) prevents reading refs during render, so animation tracking uses useState instead of useRef for the animateFromIndex value. The blocking script approach for theme hydration works without needing next-themes since it runs before React hydrates. Build and lint pass with zero errors.
